messages:
Ana (PM): Crestline asked for a scoped pilot: tenant TTL presets, a basic evidence manifest, and an audit-search SLO. Can we scope this for a quick demo?
Cody (Eng): Suggest pilot P0 = warm-window search (90d), presets (90/365/indefinite), and manifest in export. No BYOK in P0.
Lina (Security): Manifest must include sha256, canonical key_id, and creation principal. Also require control-plane normalization of key identifiers.
Mike (SRE): Warm-path only reduces infra complexity. We can promise p99 < 700ms for tenant-scoped queries if we provision a dedicated query pool for pilot. Cold retrieval remains 24-72h.
Sara (Legal): For contract checkpoints we need a one-page pilot addendum noting limitations and evidence custody fields.
Cody (Eng): Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Warm audit-search (90d) p99 < 700ms; 2) Console/API presets (90/365/indefinite) enforced; 3) Export manifest with {hash, key_id, created_by, retention_policy}; 4) Pilot limited to 3 tenants, RBAC enforced.
ops-bot: TASK CREATED - PRODUCT-5101: Pilot - Warm audit-search + retention presets + manifest (assignee: Cody). Due 2026-07-01.
Ana (PM): Next steps: Cody posts spec by Friday; Mike posts infra cost; Lina/Sara provide manifest + legal checklist. I'll confirm pilot scope with Crestline.
